response.description:
In mid-November 2026, the following updates and
enhancements were made to Azure SQL:  
 In
     SSMS, the new Create and Apply wizards make it simpler to create and use
     .dacpac and .bacpac files. The new feature consolidates and replaces the
     various data-tier application-related wizards with a modern, guided
     experience. 
 With
     Transparent Data Encryption (TDE), you can now temporarily halt the
     encryption scan on a database (suspending) and subsequently re-enable it
     (resuming) from the point of suspension. Suspend and resume help reduce
     the resource load of the TDE encryption scan, minimizing its impact on
     user workloads, database maintenance, and other operations. You can
     suspend the scan during periods of high activity and resume it when
     sufficient resources are available
 Configure
     and lock time-based immutability for your Azure SQL Managed Instance LTR
     backups. Additionally, you can enable or remove legal holds on existing
     LTR backups to apply immutability for legal or audit purposes.
 AI
     assisted query performance tuning helps you find and fix slow SQL queries.
     The Agent analyzes query plans and recommends query rewrites, query hints,
     and missing indexes, backing each recommendation by evidence and
     validation. 
 Bring
     your own model (BYOM) to GitHub Copilot in SQL Server Management Studio
     (SSMS). Connect to a Microsoft Foundry deployment or another supported
     provider to use models that fit your workflow and organizational
     requirements, without leaving SSMS. 
 GitHub
     Copilot in SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) 22.12.1 introduces a new
     chat experience powered by the GitHub Copilot SDK, the same foundation
     used in GitHub Copilot in Visual Studio and other GitHub Copilot
     experiences. 
 Preserve
     your open query tabs and unsaved edits when you close SQL Server
     Management Studio (SSMS) and restore them the next time you open it. Learn more:SSMS Create and Apply wizards
